title: Timeline, Calendar, Travel Window & Timed Event Planning
objective: Extend the prepared MAS Adventure workspace with deterministic Timeline, Calendar, Travel Window and Timed Event Planning over the MAS-01..08 foundations while preserving the boundary between prepared scheduling/planning semantics and canonical live time, travel, event occurrence and runtime mutation.

scope.purpose: Represent prepared Timeline, Calendar, Travel Window and Timed Event planning inside the MAS workspace without treating planned time or events as live elapsed time, travel completion, occurrence or canonical runtime mutation.
scope.completion_gate: A representative MAS workspace can deterministically plan timeline, calendar, travel-window and timed-event material over the completed MAS foundations with explicit references and fail-closed invalid states while preserving canonical time/travel/event runtime authority and never treating prepared planning as executed live truth.

selection_boundaries: MAS-01 through MAS-08 remain completed foundations and were not reopened.

Timeline, Calendar, Travel Window and Timed Event structures remain prepared planning semantics only; MIB-11/calendar-time owners retain canonical chronology, D28/adventure-travel retains journey state, and CNI-08/Action/Event/runtime owners retain timed-event occurrence and mutation authority.
Logical sequence values never became wall-clock time, unresolved calendar conversion was never inferred, and MAS-09 created no scheduler or canonical time cursor.
Travel windows preserve explicit D28 journey/location/route references without advancing travel state or applying a universal travel-duration formula.
Prepared timelines, calendar markers, travel windows and timed events never prove elapsed time, calendar advancement, completed travel, event occurrence or Action/Event truth.
Existing MAS validation family remained active; no family transition occurred in MAS-09.
ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json was reconsulted after MAS-09, including current MSLR planning; no new cross-program rotation is unlocked, so MAS-10 is selected_not_started.
CNI-12 and PCA remain unselected; MAS-11+ and SMB-08 were not implemented by this tranche.
next_action: MAS-09 is closed. MAS-10 is selected_not_started after ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH reconciliation and requires a later owner Continue before governed start.
